MH1984.name: Muhammad Hafeez
MH1984.jobDescription: Mr. Muhammad Hafeez is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of Hafeez Sports. He ensures that production targets are met, quality standards are maintained, and all orders are processed efficiently.
MH1984.responsibilities: Managing production schedules, ensuring quality control, coordinating , training new staff, and maintaining inventory levels.
MH1984.skills: Operations Management, Quality Control, Supply Chain, Team Leadership.
